description: Read SMS and WhatsApp message evidence for accessible businesses (sms:read), including provider message ID, carrier status, delivery/failure timestamps and failure code. Filter by business_id, conversation or direction, and search by phone number (either side), words in the message, and date window. Provider acceptance is not delivery; delivered_at and carrier status record delivery. Mirrors GET /api/v1/sms/messages; uses offset pagination.

after.description: Only items at or after this ISO-8601 date or time (optional).

before.description: Only items before this ISO-8601 date or time (optional).

direction.description: Filter by direction: inbound or outbound (optional)

phone.description: Only this caller: any phone format; matches on the last 10 digits (optional).

query.description: Words to find in the message text (optional).

name: list_sms_messages
title: List SMS Messages
